contexts.text: Ahola = the Spiritual Church, which is called Samaria. AC 6534:5.
Samaria = the perverted spiritual Church. Treated of. AC 9466:4. AE 163:4.
Samaria, as mentioned in place of Gomorrah () = [the Church] as to falsities.
Samaria () = the Church which is in the affection of truth. ( = the Spiritual Church. AC 7456:4.)
Samaria = the Spiritual Church, as often in the Word: and therefore the Lord talked with a woman from Samaria, and taught that the doctrine of truth is from Himself...
The cities of the Samaritans () = those who are in falsities.
That they were brought by Elisha to Samaria, where their eyes were opened () = instruction through the Word.
The Samaritan () = one who is in the affection of truth... because Samaria, in the Word, = this affection.
Samaria () = the Church of perverted faith.
They that dwell in Samaria () = those who are in external worship.
That there are degrees of love towards the neighbour, is evident fr(mi the parable of the Samaritan... Compare AE 785:4.)
The evils of Samaria () = the evils of the will.
Into a city of the Samaritans enter ye not () = the false doctrine of those who reject the Lord... for the reason that the Samaritans did not admit Him ().
Samaria, where were the sons of Israel, = the Church in which are not truths, but falsities.
The calf of Samaria, Illustrated, Explained.
The Samaritan = the gentiles who were in the good of charity towards the neighbour. AE 376:30. AE 444:14.

Samaria = the Spiritual Church, or the Church in which charity and faith make a one; but, after it had become perverted, Samaria = the Church in which charity has been separated from faith, and still the latter is pronounced to be essential; and therefore also Samaria = where there is truth no longer because no good; but evil of life instead of good, and falsity of doctrine instead of truth. This is signified by Samaria is cut off () AE 391:29. AE 391:30.

The reason the Lord said these things to the Samaritan woman, when he sat by Jacob's well, was that by the Samaritans the Lord meant the gentiles who would receive Divine truths from Him; and by the Samaritan woman, the Church from them. AE 537:4.

Samaria, the metropolis of the Israelites, in the Word, = the Spiritual Church; and Jerusalem, the metropolis of the Jews, the Celestial Church; both as to doctrine. AE 576:6. AE 653:3. AE 724:32. AE 900:4. AE 1088, Explained.
Samaria, after it had become idolatrous, represented the Church vastated as to truths of doctrine and goods of life; or destroyed through falsities of doctrine and evils of life.
Samaria = the Spiritual Church as to the truths of doctrine; here () as to the falsities of doctrine. AE 714:20.
The Samaritan = those in the good of charity.
